content: “E nanumu, e nakapunne. Nu gi hannano'o suda tumadugupu.”
Mu numu ka pummesoo yadooa-ma ka Paul Jew-ma yadooakoohase, gi tunemayuhoo.
Soo Paul meeoo mu numu netamma, “Nu yow tubetse Jew. Nu ka Tarsus-witoo

nadooa'adoopu pana Jerusalem-wi'yoona natunedyooepu. Nu besa ka tumayohope natunedyooepu ooka te nanamooatupu unne-gapu. Ka Gamaliel mu mooasoo sopedakwatoo, uga nuka ekow nanesootuhipe tunedyooepu. Nu ooosapa ka Te Naa-witu unu soohanedu, mu-kwa'ne'yoosoo.
Nu uga umu Te Pabe'e podo meadu tumoo'oo. Nu yise mu naana noko momoko'ne umu-nagatu wutumetayakwe, susumudu nu go'e.

Mu Jew numu tutunehanewabe no'yoona oo sopedakwatoo e unnena togesapa. Tubope e geana ka mu Jew numu moohedu tuukwena ka mu Jew numu Damascus-witu nuka tummatzi tuunguna. Numme e pupua'amu-no ka Damascus-witoo mea'a, ka mu Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu Damascus-witu yaa Jerusalem-witoo hane petuse ka mu wutumetakwuse.
Oona tabeno-nakwa ka Damascus tzage'e ne kemma hee sapaga tukwukwutsebu-wa'ne'yoo besa kootabuadu pa'anakwana
e wunapow. Nu nuka tu yadooese oo nakahoo, ‘U yow ooosapa suda e masoonammennumme.’
Nu oo tubenga, ‘Haga u?’ Mee yise e netamma, ‘Nu mu Pabe'e Jesus
U suda e masoonamme ka e naka'oedyukudu tumoo'oona.’
Umu e pupua'amu nu-notu ka kootabuatu poonne pana gi Te Pabe'e unnena naka.
Nu yise ka Te Pabe'e meeoo netamma, ‘Ha'oo yise nu manekwu?’ Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo e netamma, ‘Yotsese, ka Damascus-witoo mea. Ka o u petugase, u manekwuna u natuukwedooa.’
Nu ka kootapuape-ma kootupooseya'ehoo. Umu e pupua'amu yise ka Damascus-witoo e tzakaka.
Sumu'yoo nana, ka te Jew tumayohope besa mayohodu Ananias mee naneadu oonow. Mu Jew numu oonow nobe-ga'yoo mee sokwama, ‘Soo Ananias besa'yoo nana.’
Ka saa'a soo Ananias nu-baa petuoo, wunupunnese, mee e netamma, ‘Besa manese, mitu poonne.’ Nu yabetse esoo mitu poo'nese oo poo'ne.
Mee yise e netamma, ‘Soo Te Naa te nanamooatupu pummatoo nanesootuhina ume netutzea. U sakwa Te Naa unnetoo mane ka Te Pabe'e poonnese oo unnena naka'oedyuku.
U sakwa oo waha u pooha poonnena, u pooha nakana tuwazoo. No'obatoosoo numu sakwa u tuukwe.
Nu baa-wi u matzakakwu. U ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-matoo nanesootuhina, soo Te Pabe'e suda u tumaduguna u-makoo namatzakakwunikwu. O'no yise u besa nuummakwu.’
Ka saa'a nu Jerusalem-witoo kodyukase, nu nanesootuhina, ka tammesoo nanesootuhi nobe-kwi'yoona, nu meeoo tuusoobedya.
E tuusoobedya-kwi Te Pabe'e nu-kumaba wunuse meeoo e netamma, ‘Yabe sapa Jerusalem-wi'yoona meahoo. Mu Jew numu gi u naka'oedyuku-wa'ne'yoo too'e nu-kwitu besa u wahasapa.’
Nu meeoo unakwe, ‘Umu sumuna e nakapunnekwu ka puusoo oo sopedakwatoona, nu uga umu u-kwi tunaka'oedyukudu ka ne tunehanedu-kobena'yoona kusekana, mu wutumeta.
Nu, o'no o ka mu Jew numu ka Stephen tupe-ma natatzagaze, o wununa nu mu tummatza'e, ka mu wunagapu hemapunnena.’
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee e netamma, ‘U sakwa mea. Nu oona kwinga'atoo mu wakwawa'a-matoo u tayakwu,’ ” mee'e soo Paul nanekwaha.
Mu numu oo nakapunne ka “Wakwawa'a,” meesoo unnese, oo sopedakwatoose ka puu gi mu wakwawa'a petzabena umu yise paba mee unnegonno, “A batsa. Masoo gi he-toogoo besa'yoo, gi numme-wa'ne.”
Umu wa'agena tu kwasu tzakebuekwunina toogoo-baa koosebu tapebu'agonno, ka oo manena, “Suta'yoo numu,” mee ka Paul netammana.

Ewatse suda mu unnegonno soo mu Roman tukwutumadu pabe'e umu tu tukwutumawabe ka Paul ka tukwutumadu nobe-kwitoo bigase ooka mu wupageta tuungu. Soo mu moohedu ka Paul meeoo soobedyana oosoo sakwa sumuna pumme tu wupagetase, ka suda tu manena waha.

Ka pummetu tzakunayakwe soo Paul ka tukwutumawabe moohedu putsage'e wunudu meeoo netamma, “Nu yaahoo Roman numu ooonne'yoona ka gisoo e nanehane, u gi e wupageta-wa'ne'yoo. Tamme Roman numu gi yoo nuugwe-wa'ne'yoo. Oosoo tamme tumayohope o.”
Soo tukwutumawabe ka oo nakase meahoo ka pumme moohedu-matoosoo mease, meeoo oo netamma, “Tamme suda manakwe ka ekow nana wupagetakwuse. Esoo tookwa yise tamme Roman numu-matu.”
Soo mu tukwutumadu moohedu ka Paul-baa petuse, meeoo oo tubenga, “U haa'a togesapa numme Roman numu-matu?” “Aha,” mee soo Paul.
Soo mu tukwutumadu moohedu mee unakwe, “Nu Roman numu namayugwepu, nu ewa oo e mane-kwi tumanagapu.” Soo Paul yise meeoo, “Nu yow ooosapa tubetse Roman numu.”
Ooka pumma tu wupagetakwuna hemana yabesoo umu oo tzama'wuhoo soo umu moohedu punno'o unu sua'e, oosoo oo sopedakwatoo ka Paul Roman numu manepunnena, umuoo sakwa uga gi oo tzakunapana.

Oogow mooo'a soo tukwutumadu moohedu mee soonamme, “Hekwi mu Jew numu ka Paul oo yugwe?” Ka Paul nabatoo mu bi tuungu ka tukwutuma nobe-wikoo, yise ka mu Jew tunehanedu nesumudoose, ka Paul umu-kobena bi petu.
